items.text: Search & modal focus — shortcuts >, *, and ! move keyboard focus into the search panel or app modal (cheat sheet / recent bookmarks) instead of leaving it on the bookmark grid. Tab stays trapped inside the open overlay.

Tag cloud, page overview & omnibox — the same focus and background-inert treatment now applies to the tag word cloud (/), page overview (,), and quick-add omnibox (&). The dashboard grid is not clickable behind an open overlay; closing any overlay restores mouse and keyboard access.
Move/delete popover inert — Shift+M / Shift+D, the category date popover, and inline edit now sync dashboard inert and pause grid selection while open, matching search and modals.

Inert sync — dashboard inert follows open overlays from the DOM (search, app modal, tag cloud, page overview, omnibox, move/delete popovers, inline edit) instead of a fragile ref-count, so repeated open/close cycles no longer leave the grid stuck non-interactive.

Grid shortcuts restored — ; (inline edit), Shift+M (quick move), and Shift+D (quick delete) work again while keyboard-navigating bookmarks; search no longer swallows shift-modified letter keys meant for the grid or reopens while those popovers are active.
Escape with promos — dismissing a one-time Got it balloon no longer blocks Esc from closing page overview or omnibox underneath.
Command palette Enter — Enter / Space on a highlighted command row runs it again after autocomplete (e.g. :button groups); a stale guard no longer swallows the next confirmation.

Filters in search mode — category:, tag:, page:, and status: work in > search with autocomplete chips. A lone : still opens command mode; with text already in the bar, : inserts filter syntax instead of switching modes.
One-click auto-heal — health beta 1-click fix applies redirect detection and title refresh in one server round-trip instead of suggest-then-apply calls that could freeze the page.
Health controls — page filter and sort dropdowns no longer retrigger infinite re-renders when options are rebuilt; report loading deduplicates in-flight fetches.
Onboarding finish & skip — completing step 9/9 or skipping at step 1 reliably tears down the wizard (no stuck guided-flow-locked overlay) and persists settings without hanging.

Post-onboarding spotlights — layout-versions nudge, preview-card spotlight, and config bookmarks tour receive the dashboard instance again, so classic-layout nudge and related hints can show after onboarding when eligible.

Rotating tips delay — footer shortcut tips above the action buttons wait one minute after you finish or skip first-run onboarding before they start, so post-setup prompts and What's new are not competing for attention.

Search discoverability promos — one-time Got it balloons for >, :, and ? show on the first keypress even when the grid-navigation promo is still eligible; promos no longer block each other while search is open.
Faster first paint — skeleton shimmer and category/bookmark enter animations are shorter on dashboard bootstrap so the grid feels ready sooner.
Recent modal tab caps — recent bookmarks modal and :open last plans read the 15-tab safe cap from DashboardBookmarkRows again after the module split.

Essentials on first visit — the first time you open Config → General, the Essentials layer is selected automatically. After you explicitly pick Essentials, Advanced, or Show all (including Advanced settings → jumps and settings-search navigation), that choice is remembered for later visits.

Dashboard module split — dashboard.js is now a thin orchestrator over focused modules under static/js/dashboard/ (data, render, toolbar, promos, UI helpers, …) with Playwright smoke tests for overlays, grid shortcuts, command palette, search filters, recent modal tab caps, and post-onboarding layout nudge.
Timer teardown — pagehide clears tip rotation, backup tip, post-onboarding, and pending bookmark-open timers so background tabs do not keep firing after navigation.

Help & manual — README, MANUAL, CHANGELOG, and this release note updated for overlay focus, search/command fixes, health one-click heal, onboarding/tips timing, General layer defaults, and grid-shortcut fixes.

Cache-bust — whats-new-v88 (2026.06-dashboard-release-v69); focus-trap-utils.js, search.js, health.js, dashboard-bookmark-rows.js, dashboard-recent.js, dashboard-promos.js, dashboard-setup.js, and related dashboard module bundles.
